title: Route every error the CLI prints through one message catalogue
goal: Error text is written inline at each call site today, so changing a word means finding every copy and missing one. A single catalogue in src/runstat/messages.py makes each string definable in one place and referenced everywhere else. A copy left inline in cli.py reintroduces exactly the drift this task exists to remove, which is why the catalogue is the point of the task rather than a tidy-up on the way to it.
acceptance: Every user-facing error string the CLI prints is defined exactly once, in src/runstat/messages.py
cli.py refers to those strings by name; no error literal or error prefix is written inline in cli.py
A missing run directory exits 2, with the catalogue's text on stderr
Changing an error's wording requires editing only src/runstat/messages.py
stdout is completely empty on every failing path
